question: Does forced liquidation flow on perpetual swaps carry information about the next day's return beyond what the same day's price move already contains?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-09 before any liquidation data was collected for this study. New, non-price data source (independent breadth under the evidence-rate rule). No free historical archive exists, so this is forward-only: the public OKX endpoint keeps roughly the last 18-24 hours, polled three times a day with overlap. Prompted by the 2026-10-09 review of an external video; no paid or third-party data.

data.liquidations: OKX GET /api/v5/public/liquidation-orders, instType SWAP, instFamily <BASE>-USDT, state filled, paginated with `after` until empty; deduplicated on (instFamily, ts, side, posSide, sz, bkPx)
data.notional_usd: sz x ctVal (OKX instruments snapshot, stored with the ledger) x bkPx
data.symbols: the 70 multi-premia-blend-v1 symbols that have an OKX <BASE>-USDT swap, fixed at the first run (the universe was set before any liquidation data was seen)
data.prices: OKX swap daily candles (1Dutc), close to close
data.day: UTC calendar day; long liquidations = posSide long (side sell), short liquidations = posSide short (side buy)
data.completeness: a coin-day is scored only if consecutive successful polls covering it are never more than 16 hours apart

variables.LI: (long_liq_usd - short_liq_usd) / trailing 30-day mean of (long_liq_usd + short_liq_usd), trailing window ending the previous day, at least 20 days of history
variables.Z: (total_liq_usd - trailing 30-day mean) / trailing 30-day std, same window rules

hypotheses.H1_panel: pooled coin-day regression r_next ~ a + b*LI + c*r_same; standard errors clustered by day; informative if |t(b)| >= 3.0 (sign reported, either direction)
hypotheses.H2_events: coin-days with Z >= 3: mean r_next for long-dominated (LI > 0) minus short-dominated (LI < 0) events, day-clustered t; informative if |t| >= 2.5 with at least 30 events of each kind

reporting.before_review: collection counts, completeness and descriptive aggregates only; no hypothesis statistics are reported before the review date

amendments.before: prospective start 2026-10-12; a smoke collection exists but no H1/H2 statistic has been computed
amendments.change: adds the required review methods of docs/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md (2026-10-09). The amendment only tightens the rules, and the original thresholds still apply.

rules.action_matched_null: H1: the t(b) statistic is also compared with 999 refits in which LI is permuted across coins within each day (seed 20261012); p_null <= 0.05 is required. H2: the long-minus-short event difference is compared with 999 draws of the same number of long-dominated and short-dominated pseudo-events per coin and calendar month at random coin-days (review_methods.random_event_null); p_null <= 0.05 is required.
rules.test_family: {H1_panel, H2_events}, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 on the null p-values (review_methods.bh_family); a hypothesis is informative only if it passes its original threshold, its null test and BH
rules.single_look: hypothesis statistics are computed once, at the review date (prospective start + 180 days = 2027-04-10), guarded by review_methods.assert_single_look; the date does not move
rules.anti_gaming: no thresholds are tuned; if any robustness variant is reported, the concentration flag (top day > 50% of the effect) and the cost wall are reported with it
